message.content: **Columbia University** is a private Ivy League research university located in New York City, United States. Founded in 1754 as King's College, it was renamed Columbia College in 1784 and later became Columbia University. It is one of the oldest institutions of higher education in the U.S., known for its rigorous academics, distinguished faculty, and notable alumni. Columbia offers undergraduate, graduate, and professional programs across a wide range of disciplines, including arts and sciences, business, law, medicine, journalism, and engineering. Its main campus is situated in Morningside Heights on Manhattan’s Upper West Side, with additional campuses in Washington Heights (the Columbia Center) and in the Bronx (the Columbia University Medical Center).
